name: sleep-diary-lab
description: Understand the nights you actually recorded.

interface.longDescription: Understand the nights you actually recorded. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Calculate nightly diary estimates; Summarize a diary window; Inspect wake-time consistency. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me calculate nightly diary estimates.
Help me summarize a diary window.

prompts: Help me calculate nightly diary estimates.
Help me summarize a diary window.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Night Ledger: Sleep Diary workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Calculate nightly diary estimates. Reproducible inputs: {"nights":[{"date":"2026-11-05","bedtime":"23:00","wake_time":"07:00","latency_min":20,"awake_min":10},{"date":"2026-11-06","bedtime":"23:30","wake_time":"07:15","latency_min":15,"awake_min":15}]}
positive.prompt: Help me calculate nightly diary estimates with these supplied values: {"nights":[{"date":"2026-11-05","bedtime":"23:00","wake_time":"07:00","latency_min":20,"awake_min":10},{"date":"2026-11-06","bedtime":"23:30","wake_time":"07:15","latency_min":15,"awake_min":15}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses sleep_diary_lab_night_estimates with the supplied inputs. Returns {"nights":[{"date":"2026-11-05","bedtime":"23:00","wake_time":"07:00","latency_min":20,"awake_min":10,"time_in_bed_min":480,"sleep_min":450,"efficiency_pct":93.75},{"date":"2026-11-06","bedtime":"23:30","wake_time":"07:15","latency_min":15,"awake_min":15,"time_in_bed_min":465,"sleep_min":435,"efficiency_pct":93.5484}],"note":"Local wall-clock estimates; daylight saving and travel are not adjusted."}. Shows the actual sleep result. Does not fabricate external data.
